title: Emergent and Subliminal Misalignment Through the Lens of Data-Mediated Transfer
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical mechanisms of emergent misalignment and subliminal learning in LLMs, specifically how behaviors transfer across task and domain structures. While it includes 'religion' as one of 29 topical domains for testing transfer, it does not specifically evaluate or benchmark religious beliefs, ethics, or moral reasoning frameworks.
